subject: Walter
intake_basis: Plan as written, 100% adherence; meats and rice weighed COOKED; oils/sauces/drinks not captured. Maintenance values are plan-calorie equivalents.

maintenance_kcal_per_lb.definition: BASE maintenance: lifting 5 d/wk + daily life incl. normal walking, with ALL cardio removed (modelled stairs + Apple Health logged runs/rides/swims/hikes). TDEE = base + cardio kcal. Breaks excluded.

post_cut_absorption_kcal.note: After the 2025 break the bulk restarted at 1934 kcal; +365 kcal over ~6 wks gave only +0.28 lb/wk

cardio_model.source: 23 Apple Watch stair sessions; runs from watch

anomalies_excluded_from_priors: Bulk ramp Jul-Sep 2025 base 1972 (11.8/lb) - post-break restart
BULK25-V6 Oct-Nov 2025 base 1767 (10.2/lb) - likely off-plan intake/glycogen
Cut 2025 late Mar 25-Apr 23 15.5/lb - water loss from carb cuts
Cut 2026 March sub-window 11.2/lb - water retention at start of endurance block (Mar-May combined = 13.3)

targets.carbs: remainder; primary adjustment lever; bias to pre/post-workout meals

cut_stall_tools: carb cycle: 2 high days (+225-340 kcal) / 5 low
adjustment_rules.post_cut: drop/reduce cardio first (in 2026 that freed ~580 kcal/day), then add 100-150 kcal/wk toward 13.2 kcal/lb
adjustment_rules.endurance_days: add carbs ~50% of logged workout kcal on rides >2 h / long runs; judge response to a new training block over >=4 weeks

steps ~9.7k/day; ~1 lift/wk, ~1 run/wk (6.5 km) logged; no stairs logged
